_README: COPY THIS TO profiles.json AND FILL IN EVERY VALUE MARKED FILL-IN.
Every value comes from that vendor's own API reference. Do not write one
from memory or from another project -- a stale endpoint or a response
path that shifted one version ago returns None on a successful 200, and
the run records a seat that had nothing to say rather than a seat that
was never asked. Vendor API docs are technical manuals and admissible
under SOP 8.3; recollection is not.
Keys named here must match the seat ids in PANEL_OF_FIVE:
seat_1, seat_2, seat_3, seat_4. seat_5_claude is in-process and needs no
profile.
PLACEHOLDERS, substituted into body:
{{prompt}}       the blinded prompt      -> string
{{model}}        seat's model id         -> string
{{max_tokens}}   output cap              -> number
{{temperature}}  0.0 unless overridden   -> number
A value that is EXACTLY one placeholder takes that placeholder's native
type, so "{{max_tokens}}" sends the number, not the string.
text_path walks the parsed JSON response to the reply text. Strings are
object keys, integers are list indices. If it does not resolve to a
string the seat FAILS rather than returning empty -- a missing
measurement and a measurement of zero are opposite facts.
Check it before spending anything:  python seat_profiles.py profiles.json
Check it before spending anything:  python seat_profiles.py profiles.json
Keys starting with _ are comments: ignored by the checker and by loading.
